## Left open by the earlier read (RD-140)

An independent reader judged the previous rewrite of this lesson. Fix everything below as well. Each item is as serious as an item under "Fix these".

### Findings

1. Rule L25 (Major). Problem: Impeachment is first used as a limit on pardon before it is defined. The definition appears much later under Checks and balances, but this first use gives neither a reminder nor a pointer to that later explanation. A learner cannot yet tell which kind of proceeding the pardon excludes.
   > It cannot cover impeachment (Section $19$).
